title: Syllabus Topic
description: One addressable syllabus node. The referent of every topic_id and the source of exam_weight for Decision Engine scoring.

topic_id.description: Dotted lowercase path, e.g. polity.fundamental_rights. Stable public reference.

aliases.description: Natural-language forms a student may use, e.g. 'Fundamental Rights'. Used for deterministic topic resolution without a model call.

paper.description: Syllabus paper, e.g. GS2. Free text: syllabus structure is exam-specific.

exam_weight.description: Normalised syllabus importance. Consumed by the Decision Engine scoring formula.

baseline_effort_cost.description: Normalised intrinsic difficulty. Consumed as effort_cost when no learner-specific estimate exists.

prerequisites.description: topic_ids that MUST be satisfied first. Cycles are a validation failure.

typical_minutes.description: Estimated focused minutes for a first pass. Planning input, not a limit.

command_words.description: Command words this topic is commonly examined with.
